title: done accepts an anchor run's prune of _anchors.csv rows whose source no fact of the article cites, without the goal naming that source
goal: SP-tjap3mdd retrospective: BG-5fkown4o's worker re-anchored langgraph.md and the anchor run dropped two unlocated rows of S-6buofrld, a source no langgraph.md fact cited on main; done refused (outside-touches: ledger rows of sources the goal does not name), the land removed the worktree, and the orchestrator re-made it to name S-6buofrld in the goal. done's dropped-ledger-row reason in _tools/bl_land.py does not count a dropped _anchors.csv row whose (path, source) no fact of that article cites at the item's base, so a prune of orphan rows lands, while a dropped row of a source a fact still cites is refused as today.
